responsibility: Implements the future-compatibility lint for `.into_iter()` method calls on arrays in Rust 2015 and 2018. It performs a late expression check to distinguish array method-call autoderef/autoref behavior from explicit iterator usage, recognizes `for`-loop desugarings for better suggestions, and emits migration diagnostics recommending `.iter()`, removing `.into_iter()`, or calling `IntoIterator::into_iter(...)` explicitly before Rust 2021 semantics apply.
